746710101.text: Blast! Core output is still too inconsistent. My project is done for if it goes on like this...

746710103.text: AAAAH! Y—You scared me! It could have turned messy had I pushed this button!

746710104.text: Judging by your look... You're not from the Adventurers' Guild.

746710106.text: No, I don't have the money for that... And I'm no good at dealing with adventurers.

746710109.text: I'm just "collaborating" on a project with the Adventurers' Guild...

746710110.text: Oops, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Macadell, a researcher with the Fontaine Research Institute.

746710111.text: The project I worked on was the "Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device."

746710112.text: Thanks to the combined efforts of my fellow team members, we built the first prototype.

746710113.text: Then... Well, like everyone knows, a huge explosion occurred at the Institute.

746710114.text: The project leader and most of the members of the project team perished in the blast.

746710115.text: Apart from me, there's basically nobody else who can continue the work and push the research forward...

746710116.text: But... given the turmoil within the Institute, I must demonstrate its value as soon as possible in order to keep the project alive.

746710117.text: So, after consulting with all parties, the Adventurers' Guild and I reached an accord.

746710118.text: I wanted to use the prototype Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device as the core to create a Pressurized Impactor.

746710119.text: I wanted to use the operational performance of the Pressurized Impactors to prove the Portable Mini Pneumousia Storage Device's reliability.

746710120.text: And I did successfully build the machine, and began operating it.

746710108.text: I can't afford them. They ask far too much for their services...
